paywall.heading: Subscribe to DollarSeeds Premium
paywall.description: Everything you need to budget well stays free. Premium lifts the limits for when you're ready to grow.
paywall.benefitVideos: Exclusive video lessons from Christian entrepreneurs
paywall.alwaysFree: Tithing and General Savings are free for everyone, always.
paywall.autoRenew: Subscriptions renew automatically at the end of each billing period unless cancelled at least 24 hours beforehand. Manage or cancel any time in your App Store account settings.

trial.disclosure: Your free trial starts today. Unless you cancel at least 24 hours before it ends, it becomes a paid subscription at the price shown and your App Store account is charged.

switch.title: Switch to {{plan}}?
switch.upgradeBody: {{plan}} starts right away. The App Store refunds the unused part of your current plan.
switch.downgradeBodyWithDate: Your plan changes to {{plan}} on {{date}}, when your current year ends. You keep your current plan until then.
switch.downgradeBodyNoDate: Your plan changes to {{plan}} when your current year ends. You keep your current plan until then.
switch.unknownBody: The App Store applies the change to your existing subscription. You keep full access throughout.
switch.scheduledBodyNoDate: Your plan changes to {{plan}} when your current term ends.
